verdict.rationale: USCIS runs a documented public developer platform (Torch) with a Case Status API and a FOIA/PA request-and-status API, plus developer accounts, team onboarding, a sandbox, and production keys after a demo. The core workflows (filing forms, paying fees, changing an address, G-28 representation) are only available through the account-based myUSCIS web UI, and the evidence states there is no filing API. Missing for 10: a filing/submission API, programmatic fee payment and account actions, published endpoint reference depth, and independent hands-on corroboration of the APIs.
